I farm my own 3.52 hectares of maize here in Arusha, so I have to balance what helps yield with what I can realistically afford. I will use improved seed and some chemical fertilizer because maize responds well, but I will keep the fertilizer rate moderate. I will also use a little manure if I can get it, control weeds with herbicide, and depend on rainfall rather than irrigation. Because this plot is not small, my family will work on it a lot, and I will also hire some labor at busy times.
